svg.title: SerializerManager -- Closure JavaSerializer vs Data Kryo & Stream Wrapping
svg.desc: SparkEnv.closureSerializer (always JavaSerializer) vs KryoSerializer data codecs and LZ4/AES wrapStream. 1. SparkEnv to SerializerManager: new SerializerManager() (driver-1 in-JVM); 2. DAGScheduler to SparkEnv: closureSerializer.serialize (driver-1 in-JVM); 3. DAGScheduler to BroadcastManager: sc.broadcast(taskBinary) (driver-1 in-JVM); 4. DAGScheduler to Executor: LaunchTask(bcast handle) (driver-1:41000); 5. Executor to Exec Serializer: setDefaultClassLoader() (worker-a in-JVM); 6. Shuffle Writer to Exec Serializer: getSerializer(Kryo) (worker-a in-JVM); 7. Exec Serializer to BlockManager: wrapStream(LZ4 + AES) (worker-a in-JVM)
